cases.note: Slovenski pravopis 2001 §461 lists the double middle pair » « (U+00BB open, U+00AB close) first and every example uses it; chosen by decision. The low-high pair is handwriting (§465).

cases.in: Rekel je: "pesem 'Zdravljica' je himna" in odšel.
cases.out: Rekel je: »pesem ›Zdravljica‹ je himna« in odšel.
cases.note: Slovenski pravopis 2001 §461: a quotation inside a quotation takes the single middle pair › ‹ (U+203A, U+2039), by decision (§463's own example nests „…“ and ‚…‘).
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §463: the inner level may end where the outer one does.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §461: the close U+00AB follows the sentence mark flush; innerSpace is none.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §461: a quote that opens a sentence takes U+00BB, flush against the text.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §461: input with the guillemets the French way round is normalised to » « (U+00BB open, U+00AB close).
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §465: the low-high pair is the handwriting form; typeset text takes » «.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §461: an already-typeset nested pair » › ‹ « is a fixed point.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §461: a question mark inside already-typeset » « stays flush before the close.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §461: text that already carries » « is a fixed point; a primary opener of U+00BB is not read as a closer.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §461: a comma inside the quote before the close stays; already-typeset input is unchanged.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §461: no space after the opener or before the closer (innerSpace none); the stray spaces inside the straight quotes are dropped.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §461: the closing quote sits flush before the final period.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §399 Tri pike: three dots become one U+2026.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §§399–410: no two-dot form after a terminal is prescribed (abbreviatedAfterTerminal false); the ellipsis stays whole before the mark.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §228: the dash is set with a space on both sides; navadni pomišljaj is U+2013.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §228, §378: an en dash already spaced is left alone.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §394: the dash for od … do is written closed up: v letih 1941–1945, str. 125–132. ranges.md §3: the en-tight form carries U+2060 on both sides.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §394, ranges.md §3: an en dash between digits gets the same en-tight treatment and the result is a fixed point.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §394, ranges.md §2: a hyphen between words is not a range; only digit flanks qualify.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §608: breaking at the hyphen is provided for, so the hyphen lists are empty and the text is unchanged.

cases.note: Slovenski pravopis 2001 §610: units follow the number without a break (5 m, 10 kg); § 259 «38 °C»; the draft lists % ‰ €. beforeUnits binds each with U+00A0.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §610 names m, but single-letter units are excluded by decision (m, a are common words or initials); nothing is bound.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §595: t. i. is written with a space; the draft states the no-break intent. abbreviations binds it with U+00A0.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §235 shows § followed by a space and the number; the binding itself is from the Pravopis 8.0 draft (secondary). afterSymbols binds them with U+00A0.
Slovenski pravopis 2001 §612 concerns word division, not one-letter prepositions; afterShortWords is empty, so nothing is bound.
Spaces: no space inside brackets or before a closing mark (spaces.md).
symbols.md: (c) becomes ©, independent of the locale.
apostrophe.md: a straight apostrophe inside a foreign name becomes U+2019.
